No beige trousers, no boots or knee armour, no sword, no shield, no cape, no gun, no headwear over the black hair. Match the actual official2003 Steam screenshots supplied for appearance. Transparent RGBA pixel-art animation sheet, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, 16 separate complete adult bodies. PORTRAIT canvas with generous transparent outer margins and wide transparent gutters. Each physical ROW shows one named state and FOUR successive genuinely different articulated full-body drawings, left to right; all16 complete silhouettes and entire equipment fit inside the canvas and never touch another drawing. ROW 3, attackLight3: Four phases of Daï-Jo whirlwind finisher: low windup, turned torso, broad physical staff sweep in COLUMN THREE, settled recovery; no duplicated body or painted motion copies.
ROW 4, crouchLight: Four phases of a low crouching Daï-Jo sweep: crouch, load staff to rear, complete blunt staff extended low in COLUMN THREE, crouched recovery.

Every figure is COMPLETE FULL BODY from black hair to both brown shoes. Never replace a full body with a portrait or waist-up camera bust. Keep the last row fully inside the transparent canvas. No copied prior pose. These are bounded original2003 adaptations, not extracted source game animation frames.
